ideas.title: Uncovering the Depth of Childcare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the childcare fraud scandal in Minnesota, including the alleged scamming of up to $1M in cash per incident
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate potential connections to other entities and programs
questions: What is the extent of the childcare fraud scandal in Minnesota?
Are there any connections to other entities or programs?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and corruption. By following the money and investigating potential connections, we may be able to expose a larger scheme and bring those responsible to justice.
